investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Junipergate Assurance (insurance); Platform: on-premises data center DC-B, server range 10.92.0.0/16; Database: PostgreSQL primary with streaming replicas on rack servers with hardware RAID-10; read traffic goes through pgbouncer; data-center work uses DC- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
